BiblicalUsage: Ir-Nachash is a place in Judah, named once in the genealogies. In 1 Chronicles 4:12 Ir-nahash stands among the sons of Eshton, in the families of the tribe of Judah.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the one mention is enough: a place in Judah, named in the family list, and remembered because the family was.
